nodes.description: mapping(uint256 => MintingInfo) public mintingInfo; stores tier and rate per tokenId in SpaceCows
mapping(address => uint256) public mintingRate; per-holder accumulated minting rate in SpaceCows
uint256 public collectionIndex; collection identifier passed to the YieldToken/SpaceMilk contract
string public baseURI; revealed metadata base URI used by tokenURI
string public notRevealedUri; placeholder URI used while the collection is unrevealed
bool public revealed; controls which URI tokenURI returns
ISpaceMilk public YieldToken; external token contract used for burn/updateReward/getReward calls
ISale public SaleContract; the only address allowed to call mint() through isAllowAddress
initialize(...) sets up ERC721/Enumerable/Pausable/Ownable/UUPS, prices and token address
pause() onlyOwner; pauses transfers
unpause() onlyOwner; unpauses transfers
setBaseURI(string) onlyOwner; writes baseURI
setRevealed(bool) onlyOwner; toggles revealed flag
setTokenAddress(address) onlyOwner; repoints YieldToken to an arbitrary contract
setSalesAddress(address) onlyOwner; repoints SaleContract
setCollectionIndex(uint256) onlyOwner; updates collectionIndex
getReward() external; calls YieldToken.updateReward and YieldToken.getReward for msg.sender
mint(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) external with isAllowAddress(msg.sender); delegates to internal _mint
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) override; moves ERC721 token, adjusts mintingRate and calls YieldToken.updateReward
safeTransferFrom(address,address,uint256) override; same accounting as transferFrom plus ERC721 receiver check
tokenURI(uint256) view; builds URI from revealed flag, baseURI/notRevealedUri and baseExtension
_mint(address,uint256,uint256,uint256) internal virtual; records MintingInfo, mints and updates mintingRate
changeCustomName(uint256,string) override; burns YieldToken from msg.sender then calls UpgradeNFT.changeCustomName
changeBio(uint256,string) override; burns YieldToken from msg.sender then calls UpgradeNFT.changeBio
_beforeTokenTransfer hook with whenNotPaused; delegates to super implementations
_authorizeUpgrade(address) internal onlyOwner; gates UUPS upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall
msg.sender; attacker-controlled caller used in mint guard, getReward, and burn of YieldToken
YieldToken.burn(msg.sender, collectionIndex, price) external call executed inside changeCustomName/changeBio before state updates
YieldToken.updateReward(from, to, collectionIndex) external call in transferFrom/safeTransferFrom/getReward
YieldToken.getReward(user, collectionIndex) external call in getReward
mintingRate[from] -= _mintingRate and mintingRate[to] += _mintingRate arithmetic in transferFrom/safeTransferFrom
mintingRate[_to] += mintingInfo[_tokenId].rate arithmetic in internal _mint
uint256 _tokenId parameter of changeCustomName
string _newName parameter of changeCustomName
uint256 _tokenId parameter of changeBio
string _newBio parameter of changeBio
address _user parameter of mint, the mint recipient
uint256 _tokenId parameter of mint
uint256 _tier parameter of mint
uint256 _rate parameter of mint, the rate credited to the recipient
address from parameter of transferFrom
address to parameter of transferFrom
uint256 tokenId parameter of transferFrom
uint256 _mintingRate local variable in transferFrom holding mintingInfo[tokenId].rate

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the burn source account to the external YieldToken.burn call
changeCustomName performs an external call to YieldToken.burn before super.changeCustomName updates customName state
changeBio performs an external call to YieldToken.burn before super.changeBio updates bio state
_newName is written into the customName mapping by changeCustomName
_tokenId selects the token whose name is changed
_newBio is written into the bio mapping by changeBio
_tokenId selects the token whose bio is changed
the YieldToken state variable supplies the external contract whose burn() is invoked
collectionIndex is passed to the external burn call
mint delegates the actual minting to the internal _mint function
mint is guarded by isAllowAddress(msg.sender) which must equal SaleContract
SaleContract is the only address permitted to call mint through the isAllowAddress modifier
_user is the recipient forwarded from mint to _mint
_tokenId keys the MintingInfo entry written in _mint
_tier is stored in mintingInfo[_tokenId] inside _mint
_rate is stored in mintingInfo[_tokenId] and credited to the recipient
_mint increments mintingRate[_to] by the untrusted minter-supplied rate
the rate added to mintingRate is read from mintingInfo
_user keys the mintingRate mapping entry that is incremented
YieldToken.updateUserTimeOnMint is invoked during _mint
transferFrom decrements/increments mintingRate balances derived from untrusted token rate data
local _mintingRate read from mintingInfo[tokenId] is subtracted/added to mintingRate
mintingInfo[tokenId].rate feeds the mintingRate subtraction
from is the debit side of transferFrom
to is the credit side of transferFrom
tokenId selects which rate is moved in transferFrom
mintingRate[from] is decremented using the from parameter
mintingRate[to] is incremented using the to parameter
transferFrom makes an external call to YieldToken.updateReward, giving control to an external contract
safeTransferFrom also makes the external call to YieldToken.updateReward
safeTransferFrom performs the same unchecked mintingRate balance adjustments
YieldToken state variable supplies the updateReward target
collectionIndex is passed to updateReward
the from address parameter is forwarded into the external updateReward call
the to address parameter is forwarded into the external updateReward call
getReward calls YieldToken.updateReward for msg.sender before getReward is claimed
getReward calls the external YieldToken.getReward which transfers reward value
YieldToken state variable supplies the getReward target
msg.sender is forwarded as the reward recipient to the external getReward call
collectionIndex is passed to the external getReward call
tokenURI reads baseURI through _baseURI when revealed
tokenURI reads notRevealedUri when the collection is not revealed
the revealed flag selects which URI branch tokenURI takes
setTokenAddress lets the owner repoint YieldToken to an arbitrary contract that is then trusted
setSalesAddress lets the owner replace the only address authorised to mint
setBaseURI writes the baseURI state variable
setRevealed writes the revealed state variable
setCollectionIndex writes collectionIndex used by all YieldToken calls
_authorizeUpgrade is onlyOwner, so msg.sender must be the owner for any upgrade
pause is protected by onlyOwner
unpause is protected by onlyOwner
setBaseURI is protected by onlyOwner
setRevealed is protected by onlyOwner
setTokenAddress is protected by onlyOwner
setSalesAddress is protected by onlyOwner
setCollectionIndex is protected by onlyOwner
_mint triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
transferFrom triggers the _beforeTokenTransfer hook
initialize assigns YieldToken from the _tokenAddress argument

normalization_plan.reason: _tokenId only selects the token being renamed inside changeCustomName
_newName is the payload written to customName inside changeCustomName
_tokenId only selects the token whose bio is written in changeBio
_newBio is the payload written to the bio mapping inside changeBio
_user is the mint recipient supplied through mint and forwarded to _mint
_tokenId keys the MintingInfo entry created inside internal _mint
_tier is stored verbatim in mintingInfo by internal _mint
_rate is the value credited to mintingRate[_to] in the arithmetic update
from is the account debited in transferFrom
to is the account credited in transferFrom
tokenId selects which mintingInfo rate is moved in transferFrom
local _mintingRate is the rate subtracted from mintingRate[from] and added to mintingRate[to]
